title: Stage-2 reminder continue-link decision logic (prefetch → dict → per-recipient CTA) has no test at any level
evidence:
let continue_url = case dict.get(draft_tokens, string.lowercase(email)) {
      Ok(token) if token != "" -> application_url <> "/resume/" <> token
      _ -> ""
    }
    email_client.send_application_reminder_stage2(
      resend_api_key,
      email,
      property_name,
      application_url,
      vacancy_id,
      closes_at,
      continue_url,
    )  — grep -rn "send_reminders_background\|list_resumable" server/test/ (outside draft_integration_test.gleam) returns nothing; remind_response_carries_per_stage_counts_test (awaiting_integration_test.gleam:478) only asserts the 200 counts body and cannot observe the fire-and-forget process.spawn closure.
detail: The P1 F3×E2 seam's core decision — recipient-has-draft ⇒ tokenized continue CTA, plus the prefetch-failure degrade branch — is exercised by no test. Both ends are pinned (list_resumable_draft_tokens integration test; build_reminder_stage2_html unit tests with/without continue_url) but the mapping/guard between them is ~0% covered; a regression silently downgrades every CTA to the plain URL. Behavior coverage ~65% < 80%.
recommended_fix: Extract a pure continue_url_for(draft_tokens, email, application_url) helper and unit test: hit, miss, empty-token guard, case-folded lookup, and the empty-prefetch (degrade) case.

title: Draft-saver activation hooks unpinned on the pristine and error re-render pages (only the resume page asserts them)
evidence: form_view.gleam:109 inside view_application_page: '        view_draft_saver_script(),' and :156 '        [attribute.class("prep-note"), attribute("data-testid", "prep-note")],' — form_view_test.gleam pins sibling scripts (line 321 '|> string.contains("/static/apply_analytics.js")', line 494 '|> string.contains("src=\"/static/form_stepper.js\"")') but grep for 'form_draft' or 'prep-note' in form_view_test.gleam returns nothing; the only pin is form_pages_test.gleam:337 'html |> string.contains("form_draft.js") |> should.be_true' on view_resume_page.
detail: If view_draft_saver_script() is dropped from view_application_page (or the data-testid="prep-note" hook renamed), save-and-resume silently never activates on fresh visits — the primary path of the feature — and no test fails. Coverage is 1 of 3 render paths (resume only; pristine and view_form_with_errors unpinned).
recommended_fix: Extend the existing script-pin tests (the every_form_render_path_loads_consent_script_test pattern) to assert form_draft.js and data-testid="prep-note" on the pristine page and the error re-render.

title: Six new public route arms have no through-router dispatch coverage despite existing precedent
evidence:
router.gleam:790-801: '    http.Put, ["apply", code, "draft"] ->
      draft_handler.handle_save_draft(req, ctx.config, code)
    http.Post, ["apply", code, "draft"] ->
      draft_handler.handle_save_draft(req, ctx.config, code)' (plus continue-link/resume/draft-erasure arms). draft_integration_test.gleam dispatches directly: '  draft_handler.handle_save_draft(req, test_server_config(db), code)'. Precedent for through-router dispatch exists at application_integration_test.gleam:716: '  let resp = router.handle_request(test_router_context(db), req)'.
detail: All draft logic is covered via direct handler calls, but a route-table regression — e.g. losing the POST /apply/:code/draft arm that sendBeacon (tab-close flush) depends on, or a typo'd pattern — fails no test.
recommended_fix: Add one smoke test per arm dispatching through router.handle_request (PUT+POST draft, POST continue-link, GET resume, GET/POST draft-erasure) asserting non-404 reachability.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: save (filtered persist, invalid email, closed vacancy, empty-no-wipe, 500-cap, post-erasure/post-submit guards), continue-link claim/cooldown/10-min window/cross-vacancy fan-out/uniform-200, resume (restore, no-GET-stamp, token scoping, submitted→404, closed page), erasure (confirm/tombstone/replay-404), strip-on-submit (SQL + through handle_post_form), retention sweep (closed/past-close swept, archived survives, FK cascade), middleware body-size arms, CSRF skip, public-path, token redaction — all unit/integration backed. P1 ≈ 80%: FULL for email builders, JS-global token pin, timing backdate, PostHog scrub substring pins; PARTIAL for the reminder continue-link wiring (decision logic untested) and pristine-page activation hooks (1/3 render paths); route dispatch NONE (mitigated by direct-handler tests). Overall ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Land the extracted continue_url_for unit tests and the pristine/error-page script+prep-note pins; both are small and lift P1 above 90% (PASS).
